canonical_json_profile.object_keys: closed schema keys are ASCII strings, so byte/code-point ordering equals RFC 8785 UTF-16 ordering
canonical_json_profile.strings: every string must encode as UTF-8 from Unicode scalar values; lone surrogate code points are rejected before digesting or classifying. Each string value and each object key is capped at 1048576 UTF-8 bytes, and the aggregate UTF-8 byte count of all string values plus all object keys is capped at 16777216. A string whose code-point count already exceeds 1048576 is rejected before bounded UTF-8 encoding, followed by the exact encoded-byte check
canonical_json_profile.numbers: all JSON numbers are exact non-Boolean integers in -9007199254740991..9007199254740991; each business field further requires positive or non-negative as declared
canonical_json_profile.containers: only exact list and dict containers are accepted; they must be acyclic, contain at most 100000 JSON value nodes, and have at most 256 levels of container nesting. Container, node, per-string/key UTF-8, aggregate string/key UTF-8, and malformed constructor-input resource-profile violations are malformed or status-only rather than exceptions
canonical_json_profile.out_of_domain: reject before digesting or classifying; a future GitHub identifier outside this range requires a new grammar version that represents it as a decimal string
canonical_json_profile.other_json_numbers: floating-point, NaN, and infinity are outside this profile

repository_identity_profile.shape: ASCII owner/name with exactly two nonempty components, each 1..100 characters from A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, excluding the exact components . and ..
repository_identity_profile.semantic_identity: compare the owner and repository components case-insensitively for same-repository tests, closure and reachability keys, selector repository segments, candidate exclusion, action-directory uniqueness, and repository-scoped URL/ref joins
repository_identity_profile.exact_fields: preserve original repository spellings in raw and digest-bound records; workflow/action paths, commit SHAs, refs, URL suffixes after owner/name, query strings, fragments, and all remaining fields are exact and type-preserving
repository_identity_profile.rename_boundary: case-insensitive comparison does not follow owner, repository, action, or reusable-workflow renames and does not claim or infer an immutable repository ID

github_url_profile.raw_form: ASCII only, no C0, space, or DEL characters, and the exact lowercase https://github.com/ or https://api.github.com/ prefix required by the field
github_url_profile.round_trip: the URL must parse and recompose byte-for-byte; uppercase scheme or host, stripped whitespace, and an empty query or fragment delimiter that disappears on recomposition are malformed
github_url_profile.repository_join: only the owner/name segment compares by canonical case-insensitive repository identity; path, ref, SHA, query, fragment, delimiter presence, and every other suffix byte remain exact

safe_repository_path_profile.shape: nonempty canonical relative POSIX path with at least one component
safe_repository_path_profile.forbidden: NUL, backslash, absolute form, empty or dot components, noncanonical spelling, and the exact path .
safe_repository_path_profile.meaning: lexical repository path safety only; later receipts still bind the expected blob and kind

normalization.reject: surrogates, NUL, and remaining C0/C1 controls except HT and LF

semantic_time.issue_comment: updated_at when updated_at is later than created_at; otherwise created_at
semantic_time.requirements: canonical GitHub UTC-second RFC3339 strings; updated_at must not precede created_at

terminal_commit_binding.top_level_finding_v1: finding blob URL, native review commit_id when applicable, and complete ancestor projection for a non-head commit
terminal_commit_binding.inline_parent_v1: native parent, child commit_id, child original_commit_id, exact child thread join, and complete ancestor projection for a non-head commit

ancestor_shas_projection.base_endpoint: locally proved unique PR merge base
ancestor_shas_projection.ancestor_set: complete lowercase full-SHA set from base_sha..head_sha excluding head_sha when status is complete
ancestor_shas_projection.canonical_order: ascending lowercase ASCII SHA order with no duplicates
ancestor_shas_projection.digest: SHA-256 of the ASCII bytes of each ordered ancestor SHA followed by LF, including LF after the final SHA
ancestor_shas_projection.membership_rule: only a closed, scope-bound, digest-valid projection with status complete may make ancestor membership applicable; incomplete makes non-head applicability inconclusive

disclosure_lines: Codex has been enabled to automatically review pull requests in this repo. Reviews are triggered when you
- Open a pull request for review
If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍.
When you [sign up for Codex through ChatGPT](https://openai.com/codex), Codex can also answer questions or update the PR, like "@codex address that feedback".

top_level_finding_v1.blob_url: lowercase https github.com, exact repository, full lowercase SHA, safe RFC3986 path, positive line anchor
top_level_finding_v1.provider_target_children: parse and join every associated child before returning the top-level finding
top_level_finding_v1.optional_disclosure: exact two-LF boundary and byte-exact disclosure_lines

inline_parent_v1.parent_forms: COMMENTED empty/exact-container body, or APPROVED exact clean-review body whose provider target child overrides clean
nonempty_parent_lines: Here are some automated review suggestions for this pull request.
inline_parent_v1.child_binding: exact parent review ID and parent commit_id/original_commit_id
inline_parent_v1.thread_join: one REST child ID and exact frozen-repository/PR discussion_r<ID> URL to one GraphQL thread comment under the exact parent review with typed isResolved
inline_parent_v1.all_threads_resolved: resolved-inline-only classification when the artifact is bound to the exact current head, all pages and joins are complete, at least one provider target child exists, and every typed isResolved value is true

closed_world.resolved_inline_only: non-positive terminal classification reported as resolved-inline-awaiting-clean with a complete stable parent-owned current-head snapshot; it never completes the lane, never applies to top-level findings, and permits same-head reconcile for a new clean artifact

complete_pr_snapshot.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted independently by the parent from complete raw selected-PR observations before report validation; read-only to the consumer and never derived from report, evidence, association, or merge-status fields
complete_pr_snapshot.scope_binding: initial_scope and final_scope are type-preserving equal closed selected_pr_scope values exactly equal to the independently selected report repository, pull request, and current head
complete_pr_snapshot.page_state: initial_page_inventory and final_page_inventory are type-preserving equal closed complete_page_inventory values; issue comments, reviews, associated inline comments, GraphQL review threads, every nested thread-comment page, and reactions on every candidate review request each have an exact true completion flag and a typed non-negative integer count; feature-head check runs/statuses and selected-subject check runs/statuses independently bind their exact query subject, exact true completion flags, typed non-negative counts, and lowercase SHA-256 identity of the subject-bound raw pagination envelopes and records
complete_pr_snapshot.check_subject_page_state: feature_head_check_subject_sha always equals the selected PR head; selected_subject_sha equals the merge-status check subject when that basis is selected and otherwise equals the feature head; selected_subject_kind feature-head requires same-feature-head-page-set plus exact type-preserving equality of both subject-bound check/status page identities and counts, while github-synthetic-merge requires independent-synthetic-subject-page-set, a distinct selected subject, and a distinct second subject-bound page identity
complete_pr_snapshot.terminal_selection: initial_terminal_selection and final_terminal_selection are type-preserving equal closed terminal_selection values selected under version-1 precedence; terminal-clean requires classification clean with the exact terminal artifact, merge-status requires classification clean with the exact independently contract-verified producer check evidence and does not require a separate terminal comment or review, while reaction-clean requires classification absent and null evidence
complete_pr_snapshot.basis_selection: initial_basis_selection and final_basis_selection are type-preserving equal closed basis_selection values frozen from the complete raw snapshot and selected independently before report validation; terminal-clean binds the exact terminal evidence, reaction-clean binds the exact request and provider reaction actor/IDs/URLs/times from reaction_clean_epoch, and merge-status binds the exact feature head, current base and merge scope, check subject, App/workflow/run/check identity, producer-contract descriptor, and provider-clean assertion from the report and merge_status_parent_contract; report, epoch, association, and contract fields cannot self-prove or repair this selection
complete_pr_snapshot.finding_state: unresolved_provider_findings is integer zero for every pass basis
complete_pr_snapshot.merge_status_scope: initial_merge_status_scope and final_merge_status_scope are null for non-merge-status bases; for merge-status they are type-preserving equal closed merge_status_scope values that equal the separately frozen parent scope and bind the exact feature head, base ref/tip, unique merge base, subject kind, and check-subject SHA
complete_pr_snapshot.snapshot_stability: initial_snapshot_sha256 and final_snapshot_sha256 are equal lowercase SHA-256 digests of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for the complete raw selected-PR snapshot, including exact scope/head, merge-status scope when selected, raw issue/review/inline/thread, nested thread-comment, and reaction pages, page envelopes and typed counts, all derived terminal candidates and ordering, the selected latest terminal or producer result, the independently selected pass-basis projection, unresolved applicable findings, and both subject-discriminated check/status page sets; they are not digests of report summaries

merge_status_contract_trust_anchor.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted independently by the parent from a contract source outside the candidate range before candidate report, association, merge_status_parent_contract, or complete_pr_snapshot validation; read-only to the consumer and never derived from candidate-head files or any coupled candidate/report input
merge_status_contract_trust_anchor.source: closed source identity with kind target-branch-baseline, installed-trusted-release, or parent-fixed-external; source_repository is valid ASCII owner/name with case-insensitive semantic identity, while identity retains the exact original UTF-8 source_repository@source_commit:source_path descriptor spelling and sha256 equals the independently verified source bytes digest
merge_status_contract_trust_anchor.candidate_scope: closed candidate repository plus exact merge-base-to-feature-head range with relation outside-candidate-range; repository joins the independent merge_status_scope repository by canonical case-insensitive ASCII owner/name identity, while base_sha and head_sha exactly equal merge_base_sha and feature_head_sha
merge_status_contract_trust_anchor.trusted_contract: closed stable producer identity containing the exact contract descriptor, App ID/slug, workflow ID, check name, and provider-clean assertion; every field is type-preservingly equal to merge_status_parent_contract and report association while run, attempt, suite, and check-run identities remain dynamic current-evidence bindings
merge_status_contract_trust_anchor.source_exclusion: a separate closed parent-owned merge_status_candidate_range_exclusion_receipt binds the exact raw descriptor source, repository, base_sha, head_sha, and complete byte-sorted base..head commit set; the consumer verifies its digest and mechanically rejects a source_commit present anywhere in that set when source and candidate repositories share the canonical case-insensitive ASCII owner/name identity; target-branch-baseline additionally requires that canonical repository identity plus exact current base_tip_sha, while parent-fixed-external additionally requires a distinct canonical repository identity

merge_status_candidate_range_exclusion_r.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted independently by the parent from a complete local git rev-list of base_sha..head_sha with lazy fetching disabled before report or contract validation; read-only to the reference consumer and never derived from candidate-head files, report fields, or a coupled candidate input
merge_status_candidate_range_exclusion_r.scope_binding: repository joins the independent merge_status_scope repository by canonical case-insensitive ASCII owner/name identity; base_sha and head_sha type-preservingly equal merge_base_sha and feature_head_sha; source is the exact unchanged closed merge_status_contract descriptor from the separately trusted anchor
merge_status_candidate_range_exclusion_r.candidate_commits: the exact complete non-empty byte-sorted unique lowercase 40-hex commit IDs returned for base_sha..head_sha; head_sha occurs exactly once and base_sha is absent
merge_status_candidate_range_exclusion_r.candidate_commits_sha256: lowercase SHA-256 over exact commit-id + LF rows in the recorded byte-sorted order; candidate_commit_count is the exact typed list length
merge_status_candidate_range_exclusion_r.exclusion: when source.source_repository and repository have the same canonical case-insensitive ASCII owner/name identity, source.source_commit must not occur in candidate_commits; this mechanically rejects case aliases of the head and every non-head candidate commit while allowing a separately trusted base-side or earlier installed release

merge_status_producer_implementation_rec.trust_boundary: frozen from platform-authenticated run and job metadata plus an independently enumerated immutable implementation closure before report validation; read-only to this reference consumer and never derived from candidate report or candidate-head bytes
merge_status_producer_implementation_rec.run_binding: repository joins the independent selected run/check repository by canonical case-insensitive ASCII owner/name identity; workflow_id, run_id, run_attempt, check_suite_id, and check_run_id remain type-preservingly exact; github-actions additionally binds exact platform-authenticated workflow_sha, workflow_ref, and job_workflow_ref
merge_status_producer_implementation_rec.github_actions: provider_kind github-actions requires attestation_source github-actions-api, valid ASCII owner/name workflow repository identity plus exact non-null path/full SHA/ref/job ref, null external_implementation_id, and closed parsed identities for workflow_ref and job_workflow_ref. Each original raw platform identity and repository spelling remains exact and digest-bound; semantic repository segments join case-insensitively while path/ref suffixes remain exact. Each parsed identity binds resolved_commit plus the exact full canonical closure entry and its digest. The root workflow canonical repository identity equals the receipt and report repository identity, its identity entry is kind workflow and joins workflow_repository/path/workflow_sha using canonical repository identity plus exact path/SHA, its ref equals run_ref exactly, and it has no inbound dependency edge. Every non-root job identity entry is kind reusable-workflow and has exactly one total inbound edge that semantically matches its job ref. An external job arm case-folds only the selector repository segment and requires the unique edge reference suffix to equal the canonical raw job identity ref suffix exactly and end in the target full commit SHA equal to resolved_commit. A same-repository local ./ or $/ reusable-workflow arm may retain its platform-authenticated branch-like raw identity ref only while the exact target entry and resolved_commit equal the source running commit and the unique local edge matches canonical repository identity plus exact workflow path
merge_status_producer_implementation_rec.external_app: the accepted external-App implementation-binding profile set is empty in version 1. A nonempty external_implementation_id plus a self-digested closure cannot authenticate ID-to-root-to-closure provenance, so provider_kind external-app is always unavailable for merge-status and terminal-clean fallback remains available
merge_status_producer_implementation_rec.implementation_closure: complete non-empty byte-key-sorted unique closed raw entries for the workflow blob and every transitive local or reusable workflow/action/script dependency capable of deciding clean; each entry binds a valid ASCII owner/name repository spelling, immutable commit, a path accepted by safe_repository_path_profile, blob SHA-256, and kind workflow, reusable-workflow, action, or script. Canonical case-insensitive repository identity plus exact commit/path identifies exactly one kind and blob. Workflow and reusable-workflow paths are direct .github/workflows children with a .yml or .yaml suffix. Action paths end in action.yml or action.yaml, and canonical repository identity plus exact commit/action-manifest directory identifies at most one action entry. Original entry spellings remain unchanged in canonical-JSON digests
merge_status_producer_implementation_rec.candidate_exclusion: join every closure entry whose canonical case-insensitive repository identity equals the candidate repository identity to the separately complete candidate-range exclusion receipt and reject any entry whose commit occurs in base..head; a repository case alias cannot hide candidate-controlled workflow or dependency bytes
merge_status_producer_implementation_rec.digests: implementation_closure_sha256 is RFC 8785 canonical JSON SHA-256 of the exact closure list; receipt_sha256 is RFC 8785 canonical JSON SHA-256 of every receipt field except receipt_sha256

merge_status_dependency_resolution_recei.trust_boundary: a separate closed parent-owned resolver-source anchor pins resolver bytes outside the candidate range; target-branch-baseline requires exact candidate repository and current base tip, parent-fixed-external requires a different repository, and installed-trusted-release additionally requires a separate closed parent-owned installed release manifest/provenance receipt. The resolution receipt is frozen independently before report and complete-snapshot validation and joins that anchor plus the exact producer implementation receipt digest
merge_status_dependency_resolution_recei.record_coverage: records byte-key-sort and exactly cover every canonical implementation closure entry by original repository spelling, immutable commit, a path accepted by safe_repository_path_profile, kind, and blob SHA-256; blob digest alone is never entry identity, and canonical case-insensitive repository identity plus exact commit/path identifies exactly one kind and blob. Each raw record remains type-preserving and digest-bound, binds the exact parser profile and source digest, and records the complete discovered reference list, including an explicit empty list only when parsing found none
merge_status_dependency_resolution_recei.edge_bijection: each discovered reference carries its exact raw canonical target entry and produces exactly one full source-entry/reference/target-entry edge; within each source-entry record, canonical selector identity consists of the case-insensitive repository segment plus the exact remaining raw selector suffix and identifies exactly one target. The sorted exact raw edge list must equal that projection with no missing, extra, duplicate, case-alias, or coupled-forged edge. Reachability keys use canonical repository identity plus exact commit/path/kind/blob. The root job identity joins the root workflow using canonical repository identity plus exact remaining fields and has no inbound edge. Every non-root job identity entry is kind reusable-workflow, has exactly one total inbound edge, and has that unique edge semantically match its job ref from a workflow or reusable-workflow source under canonical repository identity plus exact path/ref semantics
merge_status_dependency_resolution_recei.relative_runtime_binding: workflow and reusable-workflow targets are direct .github/workflows children with a .yml or .yaml suffix, not nested paths. An external reusable-workflow selector from a workflow or reusable-workflow source names the target by a case-insensitive valid ASCII owner/name repository segment followed by exact workflow-path@full-commit bytes. An external action selector from a workflow, reusable-workflow, or action source names the target by that canonical repository segment followed by the exact action-manifest-directory@full-commit bytes, or exact @full-commit suffix for a root manifest. An action target path ends in action.yml or action.yaml, and at most one action target exists for each canonical repository identity/exact commit/action-manifest directory; competing action.yml and action.yaml entries are status-only. A workflow or reusable-workflow source may instead bind a same-repository same-running-commit reusable workflow by exact ./.github/workflows/... or $/.github/workflows/.... A $/ action selector from a workflow, reusable-workflow, or action source binds that source canonical repository identity and exact running commit and selects the exact target action-manifest directory. Workflow/reusable-workflow ./ or ../ local-action selectors have no closed runner-workspace binding in version 1. An untyped bare action-manifest-to-script relative ref has no declared resolution base. Those and every unrecognized relative form are status-only. Repository case folding never changes path/ref bytes, follows a rename, or rewrites the digest-bound raw selector
merge_status_dependency_resolution_recei.digests: every record excludes only record_sha256 from its canonical digest; records_sha256 and edges_sha256 bind the exact lists; receipt_sha256 excludes only itself
merge_status_dependency_resolution_recei.snapshot_binding: merge_status_basis_selection and therefore the complete stable snapshot basis include producer_dependency_resolution_receipt_sha256 independently from producer_implementation_receipt_sha256

reaction_clean_epoch.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted by the parent from raw observations before report validation; read-only to the consumer and never derived from report or evidence fields
reaction_clean_epoch.scope_binding: pre_request_scope, post_request_scope, reaction_read_scope, and final_scope are each closed selected_pr_scope values exactly equal to the report repository, pull request, and head
reaction_clean_epoch.request_identity: issue-comment kind; positive request ID; exact selected-PR issuecomment URL; exact @codex review command; canonical request server time
reaction_clean_epoch.reaction_identity: positive reaction ID; same exact request URL; exact +1 content; exact provider login and Bot type; canonical reaction server time strictly later than request server time
reaction_clean_epoch.page_state: request_pages_complete, reaction_pages_complete, provider_pages_complete, and thread_pages_complete are exact true
reaction_clean_epoch.exclusions: no_later_request, no_conflicting_provider_reaction, no_provider_eyes_at_or_after_reaction, no_terminal_provider_artifact, and no_malformed_terminal_looking_provider_artifact are exact true; unresolved_provider_findings is integer zero
reaction_clean_epoch.report_binding: request ID, reaction ID, reaction URL, reaction server time, and stable-request-epoch evidence fields exactly equal the epoch

resolved_inline_snapshot.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted by the parent from two complete raw current-head snapshots before report validation; read-only to the consumer and never derived from report fields
resolved_inline_snapshot.scope_binding: repository, pull request, head_sha, initial_head_sha, final_head_sha, and artifact_commit all equal the selected report scope and exact current head
resolved_inline_snapshot.evidence_binding: terminal-artifact kind; exact report evidence ID, URL, review channel, and inline-parent-v1 branch
resolved_inline_snapshot.finding_state: provider_target_children is a positive integer and unresolved_provider_findings is integer zero
resolved_inline_snapshot.page_state: children_pages_complete and threads_pages_complete are exact true
resolved_inline_snapshot.snapshot_stability: initial_snapshot_sha256 and final_snapshot_sha256 are equal lowercase SHA-256 digests of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for the closed parent review, complete provider-target child pages, and exact joined GraphQL thread state sorted by child ID

finding_carrier_snapshot.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted independently by the parent from the complete raw selected finding carrier before report validation; read-only to the consumer and never derived from report or report evidence fields
finding_carrier_snapshot.complete_observation: a closed finding_complete_observation used as the consumer replay source, containing a closed selected_pr_scope equal to the report, a closed finding_page_inventory, canonically ordered issue_comments and reviews arrays type-preserving equal to the independently frozen finding_page_receipt projection, the independently derived selected carrier digest, and selection_status selected-findings; issue_comment_count and review_count exactly equal their array lengths, inline_comment_count exactly equals the sum of every review children length, terminal_candidate_count exactly equals the consumer-derived terminal-looking candidate count, all page completion flags are exact true, counts are typed non-negative integers, raw digests and kind/ID identities are unique, and every record has the same exact scope and complete current ancestry projection
finding_carrier_snapshot.observation_digest: complete_observation_sha256 is recomputed as the lowercase SHA-256 digest of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for complete_observation before page, candidate, ordering, or selection fields are trusted; arbitrary or stale digests and any observation-byte mutation without a matching digest fail closed
finding_carrier_snapshot.terminal_selection: the consumer derives terminal candidates from every issue_comments and reviews record, runs the existing version-1 classifier over each, and independently applies authority precedence to derive selected_carrier_sha256; because the version-1 evidence and finding projection binds exactly one raw carrier, more than one active finding carrier fails closed instead of selecting only the newest and omitting older unresolved findings; each channel array is canonically ordered by semantic server time and within-channel ID only for inventory identity, never to decide cross-channel precedence; within each GitHub channel's globally latest semantic-time bucket, findings take precedence over clean and resolved-inline-only, while multiple remaining same-priority candidates in one channel fail closed; only a strictly later trustworthy clean supersedes an older top-level finding, resolved-inline-only clears only that carrier's typed resolved inline findings, and an unresolved applicable inline child is not superseded by a later clean even when its parent also has a top-level finding; a globally latest malformed or inconclusive candidate, contradictory classification or commit results across channel winners, or multiple channels competing at the selected finding time also fails closed
finding_carrier_snapshot.raw_carrier: the exact parent-enriched closed issue-comment or review carrier admitted by this version-1 grammar, including its closed scope and parent-owned ancestor projection, exact provider actor and App identity when applicable, state and body, complete child pagination, and exact parent-derived GraphQL thread joins; an issue-comment full-SHA finding has null commit_resolution
finding_carrier_snapshot.raw_digest: raw_carrier_sha256 is the lowercase SHA-256 digest of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for raw_carrier and is recomputed before any projection is trusted
finding_carrier_snapshot.classification: the existing version-1 carrier classifier must classify raw_carrier as findings; stale, inconclusive, malformed, irrelevant, clean, resolved-inline-only, and nonterminal carriers cannot support a findings report
finding_carrier_snapshot.scope_binding: raw_carrier.scope is only an exact join projection, never independent ancestry authority: repository, pull_request, base_sha, head_sha, ancestor_shas, and its embedded ancestor_shas_projection are type-preserving equal to the separate parent-owned finding_range_receipt; only membership in that independently frozen complete full-DAG receipt makes a non-head artifact commit applicable
finding_carrier_snapshot.evidence_binding: evidence is a closed parent-derived projection whose kind, ID, exact scope URL, channel, grammar, branch, accepted status, artifact commit, semantic server time and field, and explicit-commit binding are deterministically derived from raw_carrier and classifier output; request_id is the parent-owned request association retained in that exact projection
finding_carrier_snapshot.finding_projection: unresolved_provider_findings is the exact ordered closed projection derived from raw_carrier: one top-level carrier entry when the selected branch is top-level-finding-v1 and that top-level component has not been superseded by a strictly later trustworthy clean, followed by every exact-provider child whose complete unique thread join has typed isResolved false; a selected top-level carrier whose top-level component was superseded projects only its still-unresolved inline children, while inline-parent-v1 always contains only those unresolved child entries; IDs, URLs, artifact commit, evidence ID, thread state, and report head are derived from the raw record; if complete_observation contains more than one active finding carrier, this single-carrier projection cannot close and selection fails
finding_carrier_snapshot.report_binding: the separate page/acquisition receipt and full-DAG range receipt are validated and exactly joined to complete_observation before authority selection and selected-carrier classification; selected_carrier_sha256 equals raw_carrier_sha256, raw_carrier is type-preserving equal to that unique active candidate, and snapshot evidence and unresolved_provider_findings are each type-preserving equal to their deterministic raw-carrier derivation and to the report fields; changing report, snapshot summaries, observation bytes, and digests together cannot make an omitted, independently superseded, or range-invalid carrier selectable while either independent receipt remains unchanged

finding_range_receipt.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted independently by the parent from the exact current selected-PR range before carrier observation or report validation; read-only to the consumer and never derived from raw_carrier, complete_observation, report, or evidence fields
finding_range_receipt.scope: repository joins the selected report and complete-observation repository by canonical case-insensitive ASCII owner/name identity while every raw spelling remains unchanged; pull_request equals those scopes type-preservingly; base_sha is the locally proved unique PR merge base, head_sha is the exact current head, base_is_unique_merge_base and base_is_ancestor_of_head are exact true, and history_mode is exact full-dag
finding_range_receipt.ancestor_set: ancestor_shas is the complete lowercase full-SHA set from base_sha..head_sha excluding both endpoints, ordered by ascending ASCII SHA with no duplicates; ancestor_count is a typed non-negative integer equal to its length and ancestor_shas_sha256 is recomputed over each ordered ASCII SHA followed by LF
finding_range_receipt.carrier_join: every complete-observation candidate and selected raw_carrier has a type-preserving exact scope equal to the receipt projection, including base_sha, head_sha, ancestor_shas, and a closed parent-orchestrator complete ancestor_shas_projection with the receipt count and digest; only head_sha or membership in this independent receipt can make a finding applicable
finding_range_receipt.invalidation: a repository, PR, head, unique merge base, or full-DAG ancestor-set change requires a new receipt and observation; same-head base movement, a coupled raw ancestry rewrite, first-parent projection, or ancestry-path omission cannot repair an old receipt

finding_page_receipt.trust_boundary: frozen and persisted independently by the parent from the complete current-scope issue-comment, review, associated inline-comment, GraphQL review-thread, and nested thread-comment page acquisition before finding_carrier_snapshot construction or report validation; read-only to the consumer and never derived from complete_observation, raw_carrier, report, or report evidence fields
finding_page_receipt.scope_binding: scope is a closed finding_acquisition_scope whose repository, pull_request, base_sha, head_sha, and ancestor_shas_sha256 are type-preserving equal to the independent finding_range_receipt
finding_page_receipt.page_inventory: page_inventory is a closed finding_acquisition_page_inventory containing only the five acquisition completion booleans and their five typed non-negative counts; every completion flag is exact true and every field is type-preserving equal to its complete_observation.page_inventory counterpart before candidate selection; derived terminal_candidate_count remains outside this acquisition receipt
finding_page_receipt.page_records_digest: records_sha256 is recomputed as the lowercase SHA-256 digest of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for the closed object whose only fields are issue_comments and reviews, preserving each complete ordered parent-enriched record and every embedded provider child and exact GraphQL thread join; it exactly equals the complete_observation page-record projection before those replay bytes are trusted
finding_page_receipt.mutation_resistance: deleting or altering a page record, child, or thread join, or changing any page count or completion flag, while coupling complete_observation_sha256 and snapshot summaries cannot satisfy an unchanged independent receipt

selection_outcome_rules.application: required exact match before every report variant, including pass, findings, pending, inconclusive, and not-applicable

selected-pr.report_binding: repository, pull_request, and head_sha all equal the parent-owned selection outcome

proved-no-selected-supported-pr.report_binding: repository, null pull_request, and null head_sha all equal the parent-owned selection outcome

entry_binding.id: required-positive-integer; the stable GitHub artifact or inline-comment ID
entry_binding.url: top-level-finding-v1 equals selected evidence URL; inline-parent-v1 is the exact current-repository-and-PR discussion URL for id
entry_binding.thread_is_resolved: null for top-level-finding-v1; exact false for inline-parent-v1
entry_binding.carrier_relation: inline-parent-v1 evidence permits only inline-parent-v1 entries; top-level-finding-v1 evidence permits top-level-finding-v1 and joined inline-parent-v1 entries and normally includes its top-level entry, but after the complete observation proves a strictly later trustworthy clean superseded only that top-level component it requires a non-empty inline-parent-v1-only projection derived from the same selected carrier
entry_binding.uniqueness: IDs and URLs are each independently unique

terminal-clean.channel_branch_binding: issue-comment exactly clean-issue-v1; review exactly clean-review-v1
terminal-clean.stable_identity: positive evidence ID and exact HTTPS github.com selected-repository /pull/<selected-PR> URL whose fragment is issuecomment-<evidence-ID> for issue-comment or pullrequestreview-<evidence-ID> for review
terminal-clean.parent_scope_binding: report repository, pull request, and head equal a separate closed parent-owned selected-pr scope input
terminal-clean.parent_identity_input: separate closed parent-owned terminal identity whose kind, evidence ID, URL, and channel equal the report evidence
terminal-clean.parent_complete_snapshot_input: separate closed parent-owned complete_pr_snapshot binds the exact current scope, complete typed initial/final page state, stable canonical pre/final snapshot digests, unique latest trustworthy clean terminal selection, exact stable terminal-clean basis selection, and zero unresolved applicable findings; report fields cannot supply or repair this input

reaction-clean.stable_identity: positive reaction evidence ID and exact HTTPS github.com selected-repository /pull/<selected-PR> URL whose fragment is issuecomment-<request-ID>
reaction-clean.request_relation: positive request_id equals the parent request comment ID encoded by the URL fragment
reaction-clean.parent_scope_binding: report repository, pull request, and head equal a separate closed parent-owned selected-pr scope input
reaction-clean.parent_identity_input: separate closed parent-owned reaction_clean_epoch whose four selected-PR scope snapshots equal the report scope and whose exact request, reaction, actor, semantic times, complete pages, exclusion flags, and zero-unresolved count bind the report evidence
reaction-clean.parent_complete_snapshot_input: separate closed parent-owned complete_pr_snapshot binds the exact current scope, complete typed initial/final page state, stable canonical pre/final snapshot digests, stable absence of a trustworthy terminal artifact, exact stable reaction-clean request/reaction/actor/time basis selection, and zero unresolved applicable findings; epoch or report fields cannot supply or repair this input

resolved-inline-awaiting-clean.recovery: same-head repository-Action reconcile only through a candidate-range-external closed trusted recovery contract that binds the exact operation and inputs and explicitly declares that operation idempotent or reentrant under the github-pr-probes retry policy; tuple equality alone never supplies repeat safety
resolved-inline-awaiting-clean.stable_identity: positive review evidence ID and exact HTTPS github.com selected-repository /pull/<selected-PR>#pullrequestreview-<evidence-ID> URL
resolved-inline-awaiting-clean.parent_scope_binding: report repository, pull request, and head equal a separate closed parent-owned selected-pr scope input
resolved-inline-awaiting-clean.parent_snapshot_input: separate closed parent-owned resolved_inline_snapshot binds the exact current-head evidence, positive child count, complete child/thread pages, two equal canonical snapshot digests, and zero unresolved provider findings; this remains non-positive until a later accepted current-head clean artifact exists

merge-status.feature_head_binding: feature_head_sha equals the report head and the separately supplied merge_status_scope
merge-status.check_subject_binding: feature-head contract requires check_subject_sha equal feature_head_sha; github-synthetic-merge contract requires the exact independently read synthetic merge commit/check subject and binds the current base ref/tip and unique merge base
merge-status.parent_scope_binding: report repository, pull request, and head plus the current base/merge/check-subject scope equal independently supplied parent inputs
merge-status.stable_identity: positive check-run ID and exact repository /runs/<ID> URL
merge-status.app_binding: raw exact app ID and slug equal the independently parent-verified association contract
merge-status.parent_contract_input: separate closed parent-owned merge_status_parent_contract whose exact raw contract-descriptor UTF-8 bytes, trusted App, workflow/run/attempt, check suite/name/run identity, and provider-clean assertion equal the report association, plus a separately frozen merge_status_contract_trust_anchor, merge_status_candidate_range_exclusion_receipt, merge_status_producer_implementation_receipt, resolver source anchor, and dependency resolution receipt from outside the candidate range; the digest-bound receipts bind the exact source, actual platform-authenticated run implementation, exact per-entry parser coverage and resolved dependency edges, and complete base..head commit set so any source, workflow, resolver, or dependency sharing the candidate's canonical case-insensitive repository identity at a candidate commit is rejected, and none can be supplied by candidate-head files
merge-status.parent_complete_snapshot_input: separate closed parent-owned complete_pr_snapshot binds equal initial/final current feature-head/base/merge/check-subject scope, complete typed page state, stable canonical snapshot digests, exact stable contract-verified producer-clean selection, exact App/workflow/run/check/producer-contract basis plus independent producer implementation and dependency-resolution receipt digests, and zero unresolved applicable findings; report association fields cannot supply or repair this input
merge-status.provider_clean_assertion: exact github-codex-provider-clean semantics with scope latest-feature-head for a feature-head subject or current-merge-scope for a github-synthetic-merge subject, and exact true unresolved_findings_required_zero
merge-status.association: complete parent-owned binding of this exact check subject and App/workflow/run/check to independently verified producer-contract bytes whose success conclusion itself means GitHub Codex provider clean for the declared scope; a generic successful check or service-start marker is invalid

null.parent_finding_snapshot_input: findings require three separate closed parent-owned inputs: finding_page_receipt independently freezes complete current-scope acquisition counts and page-record bytes, finding_range_receipt independently freezes the current unique-merge-base full-DAG range, and finding_carrier_snapshot supplies the consumer replay observation, canonical observation digest, authority-precedence selection across every later correction or supersession, exact selected parent-enriched raw carrier and canonical digest, and deterministic evidence/unresolved-finding projections; embedded page counts and ancestry projections are exact joins only, and report fields cannot supply or repair any input

rules.owner_status_profile: preflight is exact owner parent-orchestrator, status complete, and profile github-codex-recovery-operation-preflight-v1; completion is a separate exact profile github-codex-recovery-operation-completion-v1
rules.source: descriptor and trust anchor are exact, closed, digest-bound, parent-owned raw records and join repository/base/head semantically; the complete candidate-range exclusion receipt compares valid ASCII owner/name repositories by case-insensitive canonical identity and rejects a same-identity source_commit anywhere in base..head, including a non-head candidate commit
rules.scope: repository is valid ASCII owner/name with case-insensitive semantic identity, pull_request is a positive typed integer, and head_sha is a full lowercase SHA. Producer receipt, implementation identity, operation intent, preflight, delivery, observation query and run object, completion, and every derived endpoint or URL bind the same canonical repository identity while preserving original repository spelling and all non-repository suffix/query/fragment and delimiter bytes type-preservingly under github_url_profile; a coupled cross-repository rehash, parser-normalized URL, or rename alias is invalid
rules.operation_kinds: the closed version-1 union has exactly two accepted arms: existing-run-rerun-full and existing-run-rerun-failed-jobs. New workflow_dispatch, manual-workflow-dispatch, comment creation, debug/job reruns, ambiguous legacy reruns, and every other operation kind are outside the authoritative recovery contract and are status-only
rules.existing_run_rerun: preflight binds a separate authenticated pre-mutation run observation and exact repository, workflow_id, run_id, run_ref, frozen head, workflow SHA/ref, job workflow identity, and run_attempt to the full independently validated trusted producer receipt. Full rerun uses POST /repos/{repository}/actions/runs/{run_id}/rerun; failed-jobs rerun uses POST /repos/{repository}/actions/runs/{run_id}/rerun-failed-jobs; each requires API 2026-03-10 and HTTP 201. The post-mutation GET targets /repos/{repository}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{pre_attempt+1}, occurs no earlier than the POST server time, and proves exact run_attempt pre_attempt+1 plus the canonical previous_attempt_url; a current-run snapshot, unchanged attempt, skipped attempt, stale observation, ambiguous mode, or cross-mode endpoint is status-only
rules.attempt_stable_dependencies: automatic existing-run rerun uses the same closed dependency semantics as ordinary merge-status. Workflow and reusable-workflow targets are direct .github/workflows children with a .yml or .yaml suffix, not nested paths. Canonical case-insensitive repository identity plus exact commit/path identifies one kind and blob; each source-entry/raw-selector identity, with only its repository segment case-folded and its remaining bytes exact, identifies one target; and canonical repository identity plus exact commit/action-manifest directory identifies at most one action entry, so repository-case aliases and competing action.yml/action.yaml entries are status-only. The canonical repository/workflow-path@full-commit grammar means an external reusable-workflow selector from a workflow or reusable-workflow source compares the repository segment by canonical identity and the workflow-path@full-commit suffix exactly. An external action selector from a workflow, reusable-workflow, or action source likewise compares canonical repository identity followed by exact action-manifest-directory@full-commit bytes, or exact @full-commit for a root manifest. A workflow or reusable-workflow source may instead bind a same-repository same-running-commit reusable workflow by exact ./.github/workflows/... or $/.github/workflows/.... A $/ action selector from a workflow, reusable-workflow, or action source binds the source canonical repository identity and exact running commit and selects the exact target action-manifest directory. Workflow/reusable-workflow ./ or ../ local-action selectors and every untyped bare action-manifest-to-script relative ref are status-only because version 1 cannot close their runtime resolution bases. Reachability keys use canonical repository identity plus exact remaining entry fields. The root job identity joins the root workflow by canonical repository identity plus exact path/commit/kind/blob and has no inbound edge. Every non-root job identity is a reusable-workflow entry with exactly one total inbound edge semantically matching its job ref under the same narrow repository normalization. The external job arm requires the unique edge reference repository segment to share canonical identity and every suffix byte to equal the raw job identity ref exactly and end in the full SHA equal to resolved_commit; a same-repository local ./ or $/ job arm may retain a platform-authenticated branch-like raw identity ref only while target entry and resolved_commit equal the source running commit and the unique local edge matches canonical repository identity plus exact workflow path. Tags, expressions, mismatched repository/commit/path, disconnected entries, rename-dependent names, or unrecognized forms are status-only. Original records remain unchanged in their canonical-JSON digests. This conservative rule applies to both full and failed-jobs reruns: GitHub documents first-attempt reusable-workflow commit reuse for failed-job reruns, but version 1 has no equivalent closed evidence for every external action dependency
rules.inputs: each accepted existing-run rerun arm has an exact empty intent list and no transmitted POST body
rules.repeat_safety: declaration is idempotent or reentrant, operation_identity_sha256 binds the RFC 8785 canonical operation record, and authorization_independent is exact true; this proves repeat safety only and never supplies mutation authorization
rules.implementation: implementation receipt identity type-preservingly equals the independently validated github-codex-merge-status-producer-implementation-v1 raw receipt while semantic repository fields use canonical case-insensitive ASCII owner/name identity. Its trusted root workflow repository identity equals the recovery operation and contract repository identity; an external reusable workflow may appear only as a non-root job-workflow identity, never as the root workflow identity. The separately supplied parent-owned dependency-resolution receipt uses a separately supplied exact resolver provenance anchor. Target-baseline resolver source shares candidate canonical repository identity at exact base_tip, parent-fixed external source has a different canonical repository identity, and installed release source has independently fixed manifest provenance; every same-repository-identity resolver commit in base..head is rejected. Valid repository shape and safe_repository_path_profile are mandatory. Every exact raw repository/commit/path/kind/blob closure entry has one sorted unique complete reference record and reference-to-edge bijection, while canonical repository identity plus exact commit/path identifies one kind/blob and canonical repository identity plus exact commit/action-manifest directory identifies at most one action. Each source-entry/raw-selector identity case-folds only its repository segment and identifies one target. Every workflow target is a direct .github/workflows .yml or .yaml child; every entry is root-reachable under canonical repository identity plus exact remaining fields; the root job identity has no inbound edge; and each non-root reusable-workflow job identity has exactly one total inbound edge semantically matching the job ref under the external-full-SHA or same-running-commit-local arm. Raw repository spellings remain unchanged in every record and digest; path, SHA/ref, URL suffix/query/fragment and delimiter bytes, and other fields remain exact under github_url_profile. Missing, duplicate, stale, disconnected, candidate-controlled, unresolved, unbound, parser-normalized, rename-dependent, or drifted evidence is status-only
rules.two_phase: preflight_sha256 canonically binds the complete preflight excluding itself; completion_sha256 canonically binds the complete completion excluding itself. Completion cannot retroactively authorize mutation and is accepted only after an accepted preflight
rules.platform_observation: completion consumes separate closed parent-owned authenticated exact-attempt and post-mutation current-run observations plus a closed acquisition-transaction receipt joining pre-observation, delivery, both post GET digests, and response/acquisition ordering. The observations share the complete frozen repository/run/attempt/head/workflow/ref/job identity, independently valid run_started_at/updated_at endpoint intervals, and a common run_started_at no earlier than the POST boundary. Accepted existing-run rerun requires exact n+1 in both post observations and current run_attempt n+1; a re-stamped historical attempt cannot pass, and any possible intervening concurrent rerun or final-window drift is status-only. Every completion field joins external receipts; no returned or observed completion field or transaction may self-attest
rules.monitoring: status-only monitoring keeps the 1,2,4,8,16,32,60 minute then hourly cadence without a time ceiling; mutation attempts stop at the platform/provider cap or stricter contract limit
